# About the author {.unnumbered}

Rikhin Kavuru works on computational biology, and on tools that try to tell the
difference between an answer and an answer-shaped object.

This book exists because of a gap between two things. The honest answer to "how
do I start in bioinformatics without a lab" is long. The answers people
actually give are short, and most of them end with "find a lab."

That advice is not wrong. It's just not available to the person asking.

Corrections are welcome, and disagreements are more welcome than agreement. So
is a report that a web page this book describes no longer looks the way it says
it does. That's the failure this book is most exposed to, and readers will hit
it before the author does.

Everything is at `github.com/rikhinkavuru/NoLabRequired`.
